newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED AFTER QUIET TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED AFTER QUIET TRADE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed a quiet Monday session slightly easier on the U.S. dollar but firmer on European currencies and the rand.
"Everyone expected the interbank market to be in full swing but we didn't do much. I think companies are still setting out their positions," one broker said.
"The (Zimbabwe) dollar gained slightly on the European currencies towards the end of the day but we're not sure what caused that slight movement," he added.
At Monday's close, the dollar was quoted at 10.8675/8825 against the U.S. dollar from 10.8659/8800 at the end of Friday's session.
It gained ground on sterling to 18.0700/0900 from 18.1800/2300, on the mark to 6.6800/7000 from 6.7700/7900 and on the rand to 2.3300/3500 versus 2.3400/3500.
